reviewer_note: Two real defects in TransferScreen.kt: (1) the Amount OutlinedTextField has no keyboardOptions, so Compose defaults to KeyboardType.Text -> letters IME (form.autofill_attributes / input-type per field); (2) the Scaffold content Column has no imePadding()/WindowInsets.ime handling, so with adjustResize the Send NbButton at the bottom of the scroll column is covered by the IME (touch.ime_keyboard). Secondary: no ImeAction wiring between Amount and Reference, no inline amount validation (errors are Toasts only).
